concepts.title: 精密ミニチュア
concepts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create one polished 3D illustration concept for a Japanese introductory generative AI seminar slide. Image 1 is the subject reference: preserve the idea of a friendly adult person conversing with a helpful small robot emerging from a large upright smartphone, with speech bubbles and an idea light bulb. Image 2 is only a style reference from a miniature brochure; do not copy its house, desk, workers or documents. White seamless background, soft contact shadows, centered isolated full composition with generous margins, no text, no logos, no watermark. Palette white, blue #4285F4, lavender #9B72CB, muted pink #EA6A8B, small mint accents. Square image. Premium realistic 1:12 scale resin miniature diorama photographed in a studio, like image 2. Adult Japanese business casual person with realistic proportions, carefully sculpted hair and subtle fabric texture. Precisely manufactured friendly robot and smartphone prop. Elevated three-quarter camera. Sophisticated corporate brochure quality.
